name: Jericho's Prophecies
source:
Based on the novel "Las Profecias de Jerico" by German Ramos Briñez, Jericho's Prophecies is a short kinetic visual novel, no other game is required to fully understand it

More than 1700 years ago a bedouin found a scroll near the ruins of Jericho and handed it over to the religious hierarchy gathered in Nicea of ​​Bithynia, but the synod of bishops dismissed it and the scroll was hidden until it was lost among thousands of codices contrary to the interests of the self-appointed rectors of the law; However, the Bedouin told the story to many men who repeated it to this day.

Ancestral masters reproduced the story and secretly studied the signs that would mark the precise time and place for the advent of the antichrist; they have prepared and strengthened to change the course of history, the battle will be subtle and imperceptible to the one who has eyes but does not see.

Just as the promised land flourished with the Father's blessing, the evil one will send his offspring to hostile lands where vices and money have built walls of comfort.

Jericho's prophecy is the destiny of humanity.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285840/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《耶利哥的预言》改编自赫尔曼·拉莫斯·布里涅斯的小说《Las Profecias de Jerico》，是一部短篇线性视觉小说，无需游玩其他游戏便可完整理解本作。

1700多年前，一名贝都因人在耶利哥遗址附近发现了一份卷轴，将它交给了聚集在比提尼亚尼西亚城的宗教高层。然而，主教会议将其否决，卷轴也被藏了起来，最终湮没在成千上万部典籍之中。这些典籍都违背了那些自封律法权威者的利益。不过，那名贝都因人将故事告诉了许多人，人们口耳相传，直至今日。

传承古老智慧的导师们重述着这个故事，暗中研究各种征兆，以确定敌基督降临的准确时间与地点。他们不断准备、壮大力量，试图改变历史的进程。这场战斗将悄然展开，那些有眼却看不见的人，丝毫不会察觉。

正如应许之地在圣父的祝福下繁荣，邪恶者也将把自己的后裔送往敌对之地。在那里，罪恶与金钱筑起了安逸的高墙。

耶利哥的预言，就是人类的命运。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1285840/]Steam[/url]]
